title: Roasted Tomato and Ricotta Pasta
subtitle: with roasted garlic and basil
description: Tomatoes and a whole head of garlic are roasted, blended with ricotta and basil into a creamy sauce, and tossed through spaghetti with parmesan.

steps.text: Cut the tomatoes into quarters. Cut the top off the head of garlic. Arrange the tomatoes and garlic in a baking dish and season with olive oil, salt and pepper. Roast for 20 minutes, or until the tomatoes and garlic are soft.
Transfer the tomatoes and garlic (with the juices from the base of the dish) and the ricotta to a food processor and blend for about 1 minute. Add the basil and blend again for about 30 seconds.
Cook the pasta according to the packet instructions.
Transfer the blended sauce to a pan and stir in the parmesan. Taste and adjust the seasoning (you can add chilli flakes at this point).
When the pasta is ready, add it to the sauce, mix and turn off the heat. Serve with more grated parmesan.
